description: This file defines the PdfLinkAnnotation class, which represents a link annotation in a PDF document, including methods to create various types of links (document, web, embedded, file) and handles their serialization.

classes.name: PdfLinkAnnotation
classes.description: Represents a link annotation in a PDF, with methods to create different link types and serialize the annotation.

methods.name: CreateDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a document internal link annotation.

methods.name: CreateDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a document link annotation using a named destination.

methods.name: CreateDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a link to an external PDF document with a named destination.

methods.name: CreateEmbeddedDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a link to an embedded document.

methods.name: CreateEmbeddedDocumentLink
methods.description: Creates a link to an embedded document within another document.

methods.name: CreateWebLink
methods.description: Creates a web URL link annotation.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the annotation object into PDF format.
